blocks.text: Try a heading, some text and a photograph. In the editor, these blocks preview using the same Astro components as this page.

parts.text: Open this page in the editor, change a heading, and choose another photograph from the credited library. Try one, two or three columns, then a navy or pale blue background. Your changes appear in the preview before you save.

Save a draft when you are ready. Use the full-page preview to check it, then publish. You can also copy your layout and save it as a template for a future page. You can also ask Claude to save a draft, open its checked preview and publish it after you approve.

Moore’s Albion story includes promotion-winning player, academy coach and head coach. The club confirmed his permanent appointment on 18 May 2018 after his interim spell. These biographical details come from Albion’s published accounts and retain a single-source label.
